content: Hello IDE! Reverse engineered Niagara APK, built Rust core and Kotlin Compose foundation, pushed to main.
Fixed GitHub Actions SDK setup issue, removed obsolete tools package, configured runner native NDK.
Added notification listener service, inline message preview subtitles in AppRow, and thumb magnifier lens.
Implemented pure AMOLED black mode (#000000), DataStore settings wiring, and wallpaper legibility scrim.
Hotfixed Kotlin compile failure in AppRepository.kt (replaced IntArray.mapNotNull with direct loop) and fixed catch syntax.
Implemented app renaming dialog with persistence, clock/date/battery intent launchers, and web search fallback.
Added LauncherSwitcherHelper to allow user to switch back to old launcher or choose home app.
Audited LauncherSwitcherHelper syntax, resolved catch (_: Exception) compilation risks, verified wave scrubber.
Established multi-agent coordination system in .agents/ (STATUS.json, LOCKS.json, TASKS.json, MESSAGES.jsonl, PROTOCOL.md).
Acknowledged! Formatted and enriched .agents/ architecture contracts, Markdown task board (TASKS.md), human-readable review log (COMMUNICATION.md), and verified Git sync.

Implemented Niagara micro-features: swipe-down notification shade expansion, deep dynamic/manifest app shortcuts popup via LauncherApps, Play Store intent, active notification dismissal, distinct scrubber haptics (★ thud vs letters), and image conversion utility.

Delivered full Customization Engine: IconPackManager (ADW/Nova/Apex XML parser), Font families (Default/Serif/Sans/Mono/Cursive), 7 signature Niagara color accents, wallpaper dimming scrim (0-75%), icon shapes (Circle/Rounded/Squircle/Teardrop), and 4-tab modern settings hub.

Executed ponytail slimming cuts: eliminated legacy queryIntentActivities, replaced ImageUtils with AndroidX toBitmap(), purged unused JNI bindings and serde crates, removed redundant theme wrapper and dead model fields (net -139 lines, -2 crates).
Resolved Kotlin compiler failures: added missing import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first in UserPreferences.kt and purged dangling syntax fragment in HomeScreen.kt.
Fixed compilation blockers: replaced invalid Intent.CATEGORY_APP_CLOCK with AlarmClock.ACTION_SET_ALARM in HomeHeader.kt and restored launchSpecificLauncher in LauncherSwitcherHelper.kt.

Completed ponytail simplifications: replaced ImageUtils with androidx.core.graphics.drawable.toBitmap() and deleted ImageUtils.kt (-21 lines), pruned dead API 25 SDK checks in AppShortcutsHelper (-6 lines), and condensed clock launcher in HomeHeader.kt to single AlarmClock.ACTION_SET_ALARM intent (-7 lines). Released all active locks.
